edges.limitations: The evidence is biochemical: no blood-pressure phenotype was measured, and only six animals per genotype were examined. Adrenal noradrenaline and adrenaline differences were not significant, despite lower medians. Mice synthesize ascorbate de novo, unlike humans, but whether this attenuates disease severity was not tested.

nodes.description: Homozygous Gly88Arg and Trp44Ter variants were identified in two families, and a third family carried His53Tyr in trans with an exon 2 deletion. The clinical and biochemical findings support loss of function. The precise effects of the patient alleles on protein abundance, membrane localization and electron transfer remain inferred; structural modeling of Gly88Arg and conservation of His53Tyr do not substitute for functional assays.

nodes.description: Six homozygous knockout mice and six wild-type mice were studied at 16 weeks. Brain noradrenaline and normetanephrine and adrenal normetanephrine and metanephrine were significantly reduced. Adrenal noradrenaline and adrenaline and tissue dopamine differences were not significant. Blood pressure was not measured.

Droxidopa (L-DOPS) is converted to noradrenaline by aromatic L-amino acid decarboxylase, bypassing the DBH-dependent step. In the founding four patients, 200 mg once to three times daily improved blood pressure and dizziness; nausea, headache and lumbar pain limited tolerability. The overlapping 2020 series reports improvement with 100 mg three times daily and excessive pressor responses or nausea above that dose. These are historical individual treatment observations, not a universal dosing regimen or evidence of improved survival.

nodes.description: The 2020 authors propose that loss of alpha2-adrenergic inhibition of insulin secretion, with preserved parasympathetic stimulation, contributes to hypoglycemia in infancy. Insulin secretion and counterregulatory responses were not directly characterized in the CYB561 patients. Failure of partial pancreatectomy in one patient does not exclude insulin dysregulation, and the later report states that episodes did not persist through childhood.

nodes.description: Loss of vesicular ascorbate regeneration is the proposed compartment-specific consequence of impaired CYB561 function. The clinical papers infer this shortage rather than measuring ascorbate inside patient vesicles. Peptidylglycine alpha-amidating monooxygenase also uses vesicular ascorbate, but a resulting neuropeptide-amidation defect has not been demonstrated in these patients.

nodes.description: Vesicular CYB561 normally transfers reducing equivalents between cytosolic ascorbate and the vesicle interior through two heme centers. Impaired transfer in the human disorder is inferred from biallelic damaging variants, the catecholamine profile and the established biochemistry of the protein.
